sloka: कश्मलाभिहता सन्ना बभौ सा रावणोरसि ।सन्ध्या ऽनुरक्ते जलदे दीप्ता विद्युदिवासिते ।। ६.११४.८८ ।।
transliteration: kaśmalābhihatā sannā babhau sā rāvaṇorasi ।sandhyā 'nurakte jalade dīptā vidyudivāsite ।। 6.114.88 ।।

translations.english: Wailing in this way, eyes filled with tears, heart filled with extreme love, (Mandodari) she was in delusion.
